y-m-02-03.title: Bhuku riri rechitatu kubva kuruboshwe, riri rechinhi kubva kurudyi?
y-m-02-03.topic: Nzvimbo nekurongeka: kutaura nzvimbo maererano nechokutarisira
y-m-02-03.goal: Taura nzvimbo imwe chete nenhamba yakaverengwa kubva kuruboshwe nenhamba yakaverengwa kubva kurudyi, tsvaga muenzaniso pakati penhamba mbiri, gadzira nzvimbo dzakati wandei dzinogoneka, uye uwane nyaya apo ruzivo runoshaikwa.
y-m-02-03.material: Mabhuku 7 akamira mumutsetse mushelufu imwe yeshelufu yemabhuku. Kuruboshwe nekurudyi ndiko kuruboshwe nekurudyi sezvinoonekwa wakamira pamberi peshelufu. Mabhuku ari mumutsetse unoenderera pasina mikaha. Mina akaverenga bhuku rebhuruu kubva kuruboshwe akati 'rechipiri', uye Seohyeon akaverenga kubva kurudyi akati 'rechitanhatu'. Vese vakaverenga zvakarurama.
y-m-02-03.thinking.0: Kuziva kuti kana chokutarisira chichichinja, mazwi ekudaidza chinhu chimwe chete anochinjawo
y-m-02-03.thinking.1: Gadzira nzvimbo dzakati wandei dzinosangana nemamiriro
y-m-02-03.prereq.1: Mashoko anoratidza nhevedzano sa yekutanga, yechipiri, neyechitatu
y-m-02-03.s.s1.prompt: Mabhuku akataurwa naMina naSeohyeon angava bhuku rimwechete here?
y-m-02-03.s.s1.hint.0: Dhonza mabhuku 7 semazingira 7 uye unyore nhamba 1, 2, 3, ... kubva kuruboshwe.
y-m-02-03.s.s1.hint.1: Mumazingira amwechete, nyorawo nhamba dzakaverengwa kubva kurudyi uye uwane nzvimbo iri yechipiri.
y-m-02-03.s.s1.o.a: Mabhuku akasiyana. Yechipiri neyechitanhatu i nzvimbo dzakasiyana
y-m-02-03.s.s1.r.a: Wakafunga kuti nhamba dzakaverengwa dzakasiyana zvinoreva nzvimbo dzakasiyana. Wakafunga kuti mutsetse unoverengwa kubva kudivi ripi here?
y-m-02-03.s.s1.o.b: Angava bhuku rimwechete. Vakaverenga kubva kumativi akapesana
y-m-02-03.s.s1.r.b: Pfungwa iyi i yekuti kana divi raunoverenga kubva rakasiyana, bhuku rimwechete rinogona kuwana nhamba yakasiyana.
y-m-02-03.s.s1.o.c: Haugone kuziva. Nekuti hauzive kuti kune mabhuku mangani
y-m-02-03.s.s1.r.c: Wakasiya ruzivo rwekuti kune mabhuku 7. Tarisa kana ruzivo rwunodiwa rwuri kare mumamiriro aya.
y-m-02-03.s.s1.explain: Kana mutsetse une mabhuku 7, kune mabhuku 5 kurudyi rebhuku rechipiri kubva kuruboshwe. Rinoonekwa kubva kurudyi, bhuku iroro rine mabhuku 5 pamberi paro, saka i rechitanhatu. Nhamba dzakasiyana nekuti divi rekuverenga rakasiyana; i bhuku rimwechete.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.prompt: Bhuku tsvuku riri pashelufu imwechete yemabhuku (mabhuku 7). Gadzira nzvimbo 2 dzakasiyana kuti bhuku tsvuku riri kuruboshwe kwepakati (wechi 4). Nyora mu a nzvimbo kubva kuruboshwe uye mu b nzvimbo kubva kurudyi. Nhamba mbiri idzi dzinofanira kunongedza bhuku rimwechete.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga nekunyora nhamba yakaverengwa kubva kuruboshwe nenhamba yakaverengwa kubva kurudyi pamwe chete pamutsetse wemazingira 7.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.hint.1: Tanga waverenga kuti kune nzvimbo dzingani kuruboshwe kwepakati (wechi 4).
y-m-02-03.s.s2.ok.c1: Nhamba yakaverengwa kubva kuruboshwe i nhamba kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 7.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.fail.c1: Nhamba yakaverengwa kubva kuruboshwe inofanira kuva natural number kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 7.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.ok.c2: Nhamba yakaverengwa kubva kurudyi i nhamba kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 7.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.fail.c2: Nhamba yakaverengwa kubva kurudyi inofanira kuva natural number kubva ku 1 kusvika ku 7.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.fail.c3: Nhamba mbiri idzi hadzinongedze bhuku rimwechete. Nyora nhamba pamutsetse wemabhuku 7 uye utarise.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.explain: Nzvimbo dzinogoneka i nhatu: (1,7), (2,6), ne (3,5). Nzvimbo yechina i yechina kubva kuruboshwe uye yechina kubva kurudyi zvakare, saka haisi 'kuruboshwe kwepakati'.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.because.prompt: Nyora, uchishandisa nhamba, kuti b inosarudzwa sei kana a yasarudzwa, ndiko kuti, pattern yawakawana pakati penhamba mbiri.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.because.hint.0: Nyora nhamba mbiri dzenzvimbo mbiri dzawakagadzira padivi pedivi uye uenzanise kuti dzakabatana sei.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.because.hint.1: Tarisa zvinoitika kunhamba yekurudyi kana nhamba yekuruboshwe ichikwira ne imwe.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.because.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Kana i wechi ... kubva kuruboshwe, i wechi ... kubva kurudyi.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Pattern yawakanyora i yakarurama munzvimbo mbiri kana kupfuura dzawakagadzira here?
y-m-02-03.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Wakanyora uchiziva kuti pattern inoshandiswa kana pane mabhuku 7 chete here?
y-m-02-03.s.s2.because.model.0: Kana i wechi 3 kubva kuruboshwe, i wechi 5 kubva kurudyi. Kana ukawedzera nhamba mbiri, inogara i 8.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.because.model.1: Nguva imwe neimwe nhamba yekuruboshwe ichikwira ne 1, nhamba yekurudyi inodzikira ne 1. Sa 1 ne 7, 2 ne 6.
y-m-02-03.s.s2.because.modelNote.1: Yakataurwa nenzira yekuchinja pasina kushandisa huwandu. Izvi zvakarurama zvakare.
y-m-02-03.s.s3.prompt: Pashelufu imwe yemabhuku, hauzive kuti kune mabhuku mangani. Wakaudzwa chete kuti bhuku rakasvibira i rechitatu kubva kuruboshwe. Unogona kutaura kuti bhuku iri i rechinhi kubva kurudyi here?
y-m-02-03.s.s3.hint.0: Fungidzira kuisa rimwe bhuku kumugumo wekurudyi uye utarise kana nhevedzano yebhuku rakasvibira kubva kuruboshwe inochinja.
y-m-02-03.s.s3.hint.1: Dhonza mamiriro ane mabhuku 5 nemamiriro ane mabhuku 7 uye uenzanise kuti i rechinhi kubva kurudyi.
y-m-02-03.s.s3.o.a: Unogona kutaura chete kana uchiziva kuti kune mabhuku mangani zvose
y-m-02-03.s.s3.r.a: Wakaongorora kana ruzivo rwakakwana uye wakataura chakashaikwa.
y-m-02-03.s.s3.o.b: Fungidzira kuti shelufu imwe yeyewo ine mabhuku 7 uye uti i rechishanu kubva kurudyi
y-m-02-03.s.s3.r.b: Wakatakura ruzivo rwekuti shelufu yapfuura yaiva nemabhuku 7 zvakananga kushelufu iyi. Hakuna kuudzwa kuti shelufu iyi ine mabhuku mangani.
y-m-02-03.s.s3.o.c: Pamwe i rechitatu kubva kurudyi zvakare
y-m-02-03.s.s3.r.c: Wakashandisa nhamba yakaverengwa kubva kuruboshwe nenzira imwechete kurudyi. Funga kuti chii chinoitika kana risiri bhuku riri pakati.
y-m-02-03.s.s3.o.d: Zvisinei nehuwandu hwemabhuku, kuti i rechinhi kubva kurudyi kwakagadzirwa
y-m-02-03.s.s3.r.d: Wakafunga kuti nhamba inoramba yakadaro kunyange mabhuku achiwedzera. Funga kuti chii chinoitika kana ukaisa rimwe bhuku kurudyi.
y-m-02-03.s.s3.explain: Kungoziva kuti i rechitatu kubva kuruboshwe, haugone kuziva kuti kune mabhuku mangani kurudyi rayo. Kana pane mabhuku 5, i rechitatu kubva kurudyi, uye kana pane mabhuku 7, i rechishanu kubva kurudyi. Unogona kusarudza chete kana uchiziva kuti kune mabhuku mangani zvose.

y-m-02-05.title: Kana mamaki ekupedzisira i makuru, i refu here?
y-m-02-05.goal: Nzwisisa kuti ruzivo rwegumo rimwe chete harwukwani kuenzanisa kureba, taura kuti unodawo kuziva kwega kwega kunotangira, gadzirisa kutonga kwako kwekutanga neruzivo rutsva, uye usarudze nzira yekuenzanisa zvakananga.
y-m-02-05.material: Patafura, penzura 가 ne penzura 나 dzakarara zvakatwasuka padivi pedivi padyo neruler. Ruler ine mamaki kubva ku 0 kusvika ku 10, uye mikaha pakati pemamaki yose yakaenzana. Zvose zvaunoona zvino i magumo ekurudyi. Gumo rekurudyi repenzura 가 riri pa mark 9, uye gumo rekurudyi repenzura 나 riri pa mark 8. Hausati waona magumo ekuruboshwe epenzura mbiri. Eunseo akati, "Gumo ra 가 rinosvika pa mark 9, saka 가 i refu."
y-m-02-05.prereq.0: Zvinoreva 0 pa ruler nenzvimbo imwe pakati pemamaki
y-m-02-05.prereq.1: Kuenzanisa kureba nemashoko se 'refu / pfupi / yakaenzana'
y-m-02-05.s.s1.prompt: Unoda kuziva chii chimwe kuti utonge kana mashoko aEunseo akarurama?
y-m-02-05.s.s1.hint.0: Fungidzira penzura imwe yakarara pa ruler, uye utaure kuti unoda kuziva nzvimbo yayo pamamaki mangani kuti uzive kureba kwayo.
y-m-02-05.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa kuti kureba kunosiyana sei kana gumo rekuruboshwe repenzura ine gumo rekurudyi pa 9 riri pa 0 nekana riri pa 7.
y-m-02-05.s.s1.r.a: Ukobvu hahusi ruzivo runoshandiswa kuenzanisa kureba. Kureba kunosarudzwa nekuti kubva kupi kuenda kupi.
y-m-02-05.s.s1.o.b: Kune mikaha yakasara yakawanda sei kusvika kumugumo we ruler (mark 10)
y-m-02-05.s.s1.r.b: Wakatoziva mark yegumo rekurudyi, saka izvi zvinodzokorora ruzivo rumwechete. Tarisa kana rinokuudza chimwe chinhu chitsva.
y-m-02-05.s.s1.o.c: Gumo rekuruboshwe repenzura mbiri imwe neimwe riri pa mark ipi
y-m-02-05.s.s1.r.c: Waona kuti unoda zvose kwapenzura inotangira nekwainopera.
y-m-02-05.s.s1.o.d: Penzura ipi pamaviri yakaitwa nemhino inopinza zvikuru
y-m-02-05.s.s1.r.d: Unofanira kutarisa kwakaiswa penzura, kwete kuti yakapinzwa sei. Funga kuti ruzivo rupi runodiwa kana uchiverenga kureba kubva pamamaki.
y-m-02-05.s.s1.explain: Kureba kubva panzvimbo penzura inotangira kusvika panzvimbo inopera. Mark yegumo rekurudyi oga haigone kusarudza kuti penzura ipi yakareba; unoda kuziva kuti gumo rekuruboshwe riri pa mark ipi.
y-m-02-05.s.s2.prompt: Zvino magumo ekuruboshwe anozivikanwa. 가 inotanga pa mark 5 uye 나 inotanga pa mark 0. Seohyeon akafunga zvakare neruzivo urwu. Sarudza mutsetse mumashoko aSeohyeon unoomesa kuvimba nawo.
y-m-02-05.s.s2.hint.0: Nongedza nechigunwe kuti 가 ne 나 imwe neimwe yakarara kubva pa mark ipi kuenda pa mark ipi, uye uverenge mikaha.
y-m-02-05.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa kana penzura ine mark yekupedzisira hombe yakatangawo panzvimbo imwechete.
y-m-02-05.s.s2.line.0: 가 yakarara kubva pa mark 5 kusvika pa mark 9.
y-m-02-05.s.s2.line.1: 나 yakarara kubva pa mark 0 kusvika pa mark 8.
y-m-02-05.s.s2.line.2: 가, ine mark yekupedzisira hombe, i refu.
y-m-02-05.s.s2.explain: Mitsetse 3 ne 4 inoomesa kuvimba nayo. Mitsetse 1 ne 2 yakaverenga mamaki zvakanyatsonaka. 가 inoenda kubva pa mark 5 kusvika ku 9, saka i mikaha 4, uye 나 inoenda kubva pa mark 0 kusvika ku 8, saka i mikaha 8. Mutsetse 3, wakaenzanisa mamaki ekupedzisira chete, wakaregeredza nzvimbo apo dzinotangira, saka mhedziso yemutsetse 4 haigonewo kuvimbwa. Neruzivo rwazvino rwakadzidzwa, kutonga kwekutanga kwaEunseo kunofanira kugadziriswa.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.prompt: Kunyange pasina ruler, ungaisa sei penzura mbiri kuti uenzanise kureba kwadzo zvakavimbika? Sarudza nzira dzose dzakakodzera.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.hint.0: Fungidzira zvinochinja kana ukaisa penzura mbiri padivi pedivi nemagumo ega ega achirwisa kona yetafura.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.hint.1: Kana gumo rimwe riri pamutsetse mumwechete, taura kuti unofanira kutarisa pagumo rakasara rapi kuti uenzanise kureba.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.o.a: Rongera magumo ekuruboshwe epenzura mbiri pamutsetse mumwechete uye utarise magumo ekurudyi
y-m-02-05.s.s3.r.a: Pfungwa iyi i yekuti kana wakarongera gumo rimwe, unongoda kuenzanisa nzvimbo yegumo rakasara.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.o.b: Rongera magumo ekurudyi epenzura mbiri pamutsetse mumwechete uye utarise magumo ekuruboshwe
y-m-02-05.s.s3.r.b: Pfungwa iyi i yekuti unogona kurongera gumo ripi neripi.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.o.c: Isa penzura mbiri kure nemumwe uye utarise nemeso
y-m-02-05.s.s3.r.c: Kana yaonekwa kure, inoratidzika yakasiyana zvichienderana nekwakaiswa nehurefu hwemeso ako. Funga kana izvozvo zvakafanana nekuiisa kune mumwe kuti uenzanise.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.o.d: Taura kuti penzura ine gumo rekurudyi rinobuda zvakanyanya i refu, sezvazvakaita
y-m-02-05.s.s3.r.d: Wakatakura, sezvazvakaita, kukanganisa kwekutarisa gumo rekurudyi chete kwakaonekwa mudambudziko re ruler.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.explain: Kana ukarongera gumo rimwe pamutsetse mumwechete, penzura ine gumo rakasara rinobuda zvakanyanya i refu. Hazvina basa kuti gumo ripi rakarongerwa. Kuisa kure nemumwe kana kutarisa gumo rimwe chete hakusi kuenzanisa kunovimbika.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.acc.0: Nzira yekurongera magumo ekuruboshwe inovimbika. Zvakanaka kuzivawo kuti kurongera magumo ekurudyi kunoita kuenzanisa kumwechete.
y-m-02-05.s.s3.acc.1: Nzira yekurongera magumo ekurudyi inovimbikawo. Zvakanaka kuzivawo kuti kurongera magumo ekuruboshwe kunoita kuenzanisa kumwechete.

y-m-02-01.title: Makadhi marefu kana akarereka zvakare ma quadrilateral here?
y-m-02-01.topic: Zvimiro zvakatsetseka: kuziva chimiro che quadrilateral
y-m-02-01.goal: Tsvaga mutsetse wakanganisa mupfungwa inotora quadrilateral zvakatetepa seiri 'yakamira nemitsetse mina yakatwasuka yakareba zvakafanana,' gadza mwero wekutonga nehuwandu hwemitsetse yakatwasuka nemakona akapinza, uye utsanangure ma quadrilateral marefu kana akarereka.
y-m-02-01.material: Harin akaunganidza makadhi matatu e quadrilateral. Kadhi 가 rakamira uye mitsetse yese mina yakatwasuka ine kureba kwakafanana. Kadhi 나 rakareba kumativi, saka mitsetse yepamusoro nepasi yakareba uye mitsetse miviri yemativi mipfupi. Kadhi 다 rine chimiro chakafanana ne 가 asi rakarereka kuti kona yakapinza iri kumusoro. Makadhi ese matatu akakomberedzwa nemitsetse mina yakatwasuka uye ane makona mana akapinza. (Hapana mufananidzo, saka fungidzira nemazwi.) Harin akafunga seizvi.
y-m-02-01.thinking.0: Tarisa kana mutsetse wega wega wemhinduro une chikonzero
y-m-02-01.thinking.1: Sarudza mwero wekutonga uye uedze nemwero iwoyo
y-m-02-01.thinking.2: Gadzira uye utsanangure, nemazwi, muenzaniso wechimwe chimiro chinowirirana nemwero
y-m-02-01.prereq.0: Unogona kuziva zvimiro zvetriangle, quadrilateral, nedenderedzwa uye kutaura mazita azvo.
y-m-02-01.prereq.1: Unogona kuverenga 'mitsetse yakatwasuka' ne 'makona akapinza' uchinongedza nechigunwe. (Kuverenga nhamba kusvika pa 4)
y-m-02-01.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsetse mumwe mukufunga kwaHarin wakaoma kutenda. (Mitsetse miviri inogona kuva yakaoma kutenda.)
y-m-02-01.s.s1.hint.0: Kumakadhi matatu, nongedza nechigunwe uye uverenge kuti pane mitsetse yakatwasuka mingani nemakona akapinza mangani.
y-m-02-01.s.s1.hint.1: Kune mutsetse wega wega, paradzanisa kana chikonzero chakapiwa naHarin chiri chinhu 'chakaverengwa' kana 'manzwiro kubva pakuoneka.'
y-m-02-01.s.s1.line.0: Kadhi 가 rine mitsetse mina yakatwasuka nemakona mana akapinza, saka ndi quadrilateral.
y-m-02-01.s.s1.line.1: Kadhi 나 rakareba kumativi, saka haisi quadrilateral.
y-m-02-01.s.s1.line.2: Kadhi 다 rakarereka, asi rine mitsetse mina yakatwasuka nemakona mana akapinza.
y-m-02-01.s.s1.line.3: Saka quadrilateral inofanira kuva nemitsetse mina yese yakatwasuka yakafanana.
y-m-02-01.s.s1.explain: Mitsetse 2 ne 4 yakaoma kutenda. Mitsetse 1 ne 3 yakataurwa nekuverenga mitsetse yakatwasuka nemakona akapinza. Mutsetse 2 wakasarudzwa nekutarisa 'rakareba' chete, uye mutsetse 4 wakatambanudza zvakaonekwa mukadhi 가 oga kuva 'dzinofanira kuva dzakareba zvakafanana.' Kunyange kana rakareba kana rakarereka, mitsetse mina yakatwasuka nemakona mana akapinza zvinoramba zvakafanana.
y-m-02-01.s.s2.prompt: Pakusarudza kana kadhi 나 riri quadrilateral kana kwete, chinhu chakavimbika zvakanyanya chekutarisa chii?
y-m-02-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tsvaga chisingashanduki kunyange ukatendeudza kadhi 나 kana kuridhonza rakakura.
y-m-02-01.s.s2.hint.1: Taura chakafanana nechakasiyana pakati pemakadhi 가, 나, ne 다.
y-m-02-01.s.s2.o.a: Tarisa kana rakaenzana nesaizi yekadhi rekutanga re quadrilateral raakaona
y-m-02-01.s.s2.r.a: Saizi haisi chiratidzo chekusarudza zita rechimiro. Quadrilateral huru neduku zvese ndi ma quadrilateral.
y-m-02-01.s.s2.o.b: Tarisa kana nzira iyo kadhi rakaiswa nayo yakarurama
y-m-02-01.s.s2.r.b: Chimiro chinoramba chakafanana kunyange ukachitendeudza. Nzira yarakaiswa nayo haina chekuita nezita rechimiro.
y-m-02-01.s.s2.o.c: Yera kana mitsetse yese yakatwasuka ine kureba kwakafanana
y-m-02-01.s.s2.r.c: Wakashandisa chimiro chakaonekwa mukadhi 가 oga semwero. Tarisa kana chichishanda semwero unosiya kadhi 나 rakareba rakatetepa.
y-m-02-01.s.s2.o.d: Verenga kuti pane mitsetse yakatwasuka mingani nemakona akapinza mangani
y-m-02-01.s.s2.r.d: Wakaverenga chinhu chinogona kushandiswa kusarudza zita rechimiro. Chiratidzo chisingashanduki kunyange chimiro chakareba chakatetepa kana chakarereka.
y-m-02-01.s.s2.explain: Kuti pane mitsetse yakatwasuka mingani nemakona akapinza mangani zviratidzo zvisingashanduki kunyange ukaita chimiro chikuru kana kuchitendeudza. Saizi, nzira yaakaiswa nayo, nekana kureba kwakafanana hazvigoni kushandiswa semwero wekusarudza zita rechimiro.
y-m-02-01.s.s3.prompt: Nyora zvaungati kuna Harin. Tsanangura nemazwi kadhi rimwe rinoratidzika rakasiyana ne 가 asi richiri quadrilateral (semuenzaniso, rakareba zvakadini, rakaiswa sei), uye unyore chikonzero chekuti sei rinogona kunzi quadrilateral.

y-m-02-02.title: Chikuru chinorema here? Kuchisimudza nekuchirema
y-m-02-02.goal: Ona kuti pfungwa 'chikuru chinorema' yakarurama rinhi uye isina kururama rinhi, ramba uchigadzirisa kutonga kwako pese painouya ruzivo rutsva, uye gadzira peya yakafanana musaizi asi inoratidzika kusiyana muhuremu.
y-m-02-02.material: Jiho akati, "Chikuru chinorema." Mudzidzisi akati ngatiedzei mazwi aJiho. Anoratidza zvinhu zviviri panguva imwe, unozvisimudza nemaoko ese maviri, uye pakupedzisira unotarisa nekuzviisa pachiyero. (Pachiyero, divi rinorema rinodzika.)
y-m-02-02.thinking.0: Tonga kushandura kana kuchengeta kutonga kwako neruzivo rutsva
y-m-02-02.prereq.0: Ruzivo rwekusimudza zvinhu zviviri nemaoko ese maviri uye kutaura kuti zvinorema/zvinopfava
y-m-02-02.prereq.1: Kuziva kuti pachiyero (seesaw), divi rinodzika rinorema.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.prompt: Pese painouya ruzivo rutsva, funga kuti divi ripi richarema. Kana ruzivo rutsva rwauya, zvakanaka kuchengeta pfungwa yako kana kuishandura.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.hint.0: Tarisa ruzivo rwega rwega uye tanga wataura chinhu chimwe chakafanana nechimwe chakasiyana nepeya yekupedzisira.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.hint.1: Taura kuti mhinduro yawakasarudza yakavakirwa pachikamu chipi cheruzivo urwu.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Peya yekutanga: matombo maviri erudzi rumwe chete. Rimwe rakakura sechibatiso uye rimwe rakaduku semucheka.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Kana iri matombo erudzi rumwe chete, zvakanaka kufungidzira kuti ibwe guru rinorema uye kutaura kuti uchasarudza mushure mekuzvisimudza. Mupeya iyi, 'chikuru chinorema' chinowirirana zvakanaka.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Izvi zvakashandisa pfungwa yokuti kana iri rudzi rumwe chete, chikuru chine zvinhu zvakawanda mukati.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Hapasati paine chiratidzo chekufunga kuti duku rinorema. Rangarira kuti chiratidzo chipi chakakuita kuti ufunge saizvozvo.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Iyi pfungwa inungwarira inoda kutanga yatarisa. Funga zvakarewo kuti pane zviratidzo zvingani.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Kana zvasimudzwa nemaoko ese maviri, ruoko rwakabata ibwe guru rwakadzika zvakanyanya. Peya yechipiri irudzi rwakasiyana. Rimwe ibhora resiponji rakakura sezvanza mbiri (rinopinda pakarepo kana ukarinyatsodzvanya), uye rimwe ibhora rakaita nesutiri rakaduku sechipikiri.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Panguva ino, unofunga kuti divi ripi richarema?
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Kungori peya yekutanga yakarurama, haugoni kushandisa pfungwa imwe chete kupeya iyi. Izvi nokuti chinhu chakasiyana. Kufungidzira kuti bhora resutiri rinoratidzika kurema nekutaura kuti zvakaoma kusarudza kubva pasaizi oga zvese zvakakodzera.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wakatakura pfungwa yakarurama mupeya yekutanga sezvayakaita. Kupeya iyi, tanga watarisa kana chinhu chakafanana.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wakashandisa musiyano wechinhu (siponji inodzvanyika nesutiri yakaoma) sechiratidzo.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Chinhu chakasiyana, saka zvakaoma kusarudza kubva pasaizi oga
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Waona kuti chiratidzo kunze kwesaizi chinodikanwa. Funga zvakarewo kuti ungaite sei kutarisa.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Kana zvaiswa pachiyero, divi rine bhora diki resutiri rakadzika. Divi rine bhora guru resiponji rakakwira.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Nzira yakanaka yekugadzirisa mazwi aJiho "Chikuru chinorema" ndeipi?
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Inobatsira pakati pezvinhu zvakafanana, asi kana marudzi akasiyana, saizi oga haigoni kusarudza huremu. Saka 'nguva dzose' yakasimba zvikuru, uye kunyange ukafungidzira nesaizi, zvinovimbika zvakanyanya kutarisa nekusimudza kana kushandisa chiyero.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Hazvisi nguva dzose. Kana rakanga riri rudzi rumwe chete, rakakura rakanga rakarema, asi kana marudzi akasiyana, zvakasiyana.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Ndakapatsanura kuva matombo maviri nepeya mbiri dzesiponji nebhora resutiri ndikazvitaura.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wakatambanudza mhedzisiro yepeya imwe kuti ifukidze nyaya dzese. Rangarira zvakare kuti matombo ari mupeya yekutanga akanga akaita sei.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Jiho akarurama. Bhora resiponji rakakura, saka chiyero chakanganisa.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Kana zvaitarisirwa nemhedzisiro zvakasiyana, wakakahadzika mhedzisiro. Tarisazve zvawakatarisa nechiyero.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Usatonge nesaizi; unofanira kutarisa nekusimudza kana kuisa pachiyero.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Wakasarudza nzira yekutarisa zvakananga panzvimbo pekutevera saizi.
y-m-02-02.s.s1.reflect: Mupeya yekutanga, pfungwa yokuti 'ibwe guru rinorema' yaiva kutonga kwaigona kuchengetwa, uye mupeya yechipiri, ruzivo rutsva rwokuti chinhu chinoshanduka rwaireva kuti pfungwa iyoyo yakanga isingachagoni kushandiswa sezvayakaita. Poindi huru yebasa iri ndeyokutaura kusvika kuruzivo rupi pfungwa yako iri yakarurama nekuwedzera mamiriro.
y-m-02-02.s.s2.prompt: Nyora peya imwe yezvinhu zviviri zvinoratidzika zvakafanana musaizi asi zvinoratidzika kusiyana zvikuru muhuremu. Uye unyore kuti ungazvitarisa sei.
y-m-02-02.s.s2.hint.0: Funga zvinhu zviviri mukirasi kana kumba kwako uye tanga waenzanisa saizi dzazvo.
y-m-02-02.s.s2.hint.1: Funga kuti ungazvinzwa sei kana ukabata zvinhu zviviri izvozvo chimwe muruoko rumwe nerumwe, uye kuti divi ripi richadzika kana ukazviisa pachiyero.
y-m-02-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Zvinhu zviviri zvawakasarudza zvakafanana chaizvo musaizi here?
y-m-02-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Wakasarudza here kuti ndechipi pazvinhu zviviri chaunofunga chinorema?
y-m-02-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Unogona kuenzanisa huremu nenzira yawakanyora here?
y-m-02-02.s.s2.model.0: Bhora rekotoni nebwe diki zvakafanana musaizi, asi ndinofunga bwe diki rinorema. Ndaitarisa nekubata rimwe muruoko rumwe nerumwe kana kuzviisa pachiyero.
y-m-02-02.s.s2.model.1: Bhokisi risina chinhu nebhokisi rine mabhuku mukati zvakafanana saizi, asi bhokisi rine mabhuku rinorema. Kana ndikazviisa pachiyero, ndinogona kuziva kuti divi ripi rinodzika.
y-m-02-02.s.s2.modelNote.1: Muenzaniso apo chiri mukati chechinhu chimwe chakasiyana chinoshandawo.

y-m-02-04.title: Kapu refu rinobata mvura yakawanda here?
y-m-02-04.goal: Sarudza nzira dzinovimbika dzekuyedza pfungwa yekuti 'kana ichireba, inobata zvakawanda,' tonga nemhedzisiro yekudurura kubva kune imwe kuenda kune imwe, uye ugadzire nemashoko chimiro chemakapu apo pfungwa iyoyo isina kururama.
y-m-02-04.material: Kapu 가 i kapu refu zvikuru, rakamonera. Kapu 나 i kapu pfupi, rakapamhama zvikuru. Makapu ose maviri akavhurika kumusoro uye akatsetseka mukati. Ain akati, "가 i refu, saka 가 inobata mvura yakawanda." Junho akati, "Ngatirege kutevera zvatinoona, titarisei nemvura."
y-m-02-04.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza nzira dzose dzekuziva zvakavimbika kuti kapu ipi inobata mvura yakawanda.
y-m-02-04.s.s1.hint.0: Kunze kwekutarisa nemeso, funga nzira yekuenzanisa makapu maviri nemvura chaiyo.
y-m-02-04.s.s1.hint.1: Taura nemashoko, rimwe nerimwe, kuti nzira imwe neimwe inoyera kana kuenzanisa chii chaizvo, uye utarise kana izvozvo zvakafanana ne 'huwandu hwemvura hwainobata.'
y-m-02-04.s.s1.o.a: Isa makapu maviri padivi pedivi uye utarise hurefu chete
y-m-02-04.s.s1.r.a: Hurefu i chiratidzo chimwe chete. Haugone kuziva kuti kapu yakapamhama sei.
y-m-02-04.s.s1.o.b: Dururira mvura yakazadzwa kusvika kumusoro kwekapu 가 mukapu 나 uye utarise
y-m-02-04.s.s1.r.b: Iyi i nzira yekudurura mvura zvakananga kuenzanisa hukuru hwemakapu maviri. Funga zvakare kuti ungaverenga sei mhedzisiro.
y-m-02-04.s.s1.o.c: Akwidze nemaoko ako uye usarudze kapu inorema
y-m-02-04.s.s1.r.c: Waizoyera kapu pachayo. Funga kana izvozvo zvakafanana nehuwandu hwemvura hwainobata.
y-m-02-04.s.s1.o.d: Verenga kuti unozadza kangani nechidziyo chidiki chimwechete
y-m-02-04.s.s1.r.d: Iyi i nzira inoshandisa chidziyo chimwechete sechikamu uye inoenzanisa makapu maviri nechiyero chimwechete.
y-m-02-04.s.s1.explain: Kana ukadurura mvura zvakananga kana kuverenga kuti unozadza kangani nechidziyo chimwechete, unogona kuenzanisa huwandu hwemvura hunobatwa nemakapu, chero ari mashape api. Kutarisa hurefu chete kana kusimudza makapu asina chinhu hakuenzanisi zvakananga huwandu hwemvura hwainobata.
y-m-02-04.s.s1.acc.0: Kudurura oga kunogona kupa mhedzisiro inovimbika. Zvakanaka kuzivawo kuti kune nzira yekuverenga nechidziyo chimwechete.
y-m-02-04.s.s1.acc.1: Nzira yekuverenga nguva nechidziyo chidiki chimwechete inovimbikawo. Zvakanaka kuzivawo kuti kune nzira yekudurura.
y-m-02-04.s.s2.prompt: Junho akazadza kapu 가 nemvura uye akaidurura yose mukapu 나 pasina kuteuka kunyange dota rimwe, uye mvura iri mukapu 나 yakazadza hafu yekapu chete. Chii chinogona kutaurwa kubva pamhedzisiro iyi?
y-m-02-04.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora nemashoko zvose kuti mvura iri mukapu 가 yaiva huwandu hwakazara uye kuti kapu 나 haina kuzadzwa nemvura iyoyo.
y-m-02-04.s.s2.hint.1: Mushure mekudurura mvura yose kubva mukapu 가, dhonza mufananidzo wekuti kapu 나 yakazadzwa kusvika kupi uye kana pane nzvimbo isina chinhu yakasara.
y-m-02-04.s.s2.r.a: Waverenga kuti mvura yakadururwa haina kuzadza kapu, uye wakaenzanisa hukuru hwemakapu maviri.
y-m-02-04.s.s2.r.b: Wakaisa pfungwa yekutanga yekuti i refu pamberi pemhedzisiro. Funga kuti zvinoreva chii kuti mvura yose ye 가 yakatamiswa uye 나 haina kuzara.
y-m-02-04.s.s2.o.c: Makapu maviri anobata huwandu hwemvura hwakaenzana
y-m-02-04.s.s2.r.c: Tarisa kana mvura yakazadza kapu yakazadza kapu 나.
y-m-02-04.s.s2.r.d: Kutarisa kamwe zvakare i tsika yakanaka. Asi kana mvura yose yakatamiswa pasina kuteuka, tarisa kana pane chimwe chinhu mhedzisiro iyi oga inokubvumira kutaura.
y-m-02-04.s.s2.explain: Mvura yakazadza kapu 가 yakazadza hafu chete yekapu 나, saka kapu 나 inogona kubata mvura yakawanda kupfuura iyoyo. Pfungwa yekutanga (kana ichireba, inobata zvakawanda) yakanga isina kururama kune peya iyi yemakapu.
y-m-02-04.s.s3.prompt: Tsanangura nemashoko makapu maviri matsva (kapu 다 nekapu 라) apo "kana yakareba, inobata mvura yakawanda" yaAin ingasava yakarurama. Anofanira kuva makapu akasiyana ne 가 ne 나; nyora hurefu neupamhi hwemakapu maviri nenhamba kana mashoko (semuenzaniso, hurefu 20 cm, upamhi 3 cm), uye unyorewo kuti kapu ipi inobata mvura yakawanda.
y-m-02-04.s.s3.hint.0: Fungidzira makapu maviri nekusarudza nhamba dzakasiyana ne 가 ne 나 (hurefu mu cm, upamhi mu cm). Tsvaga kuti chii chimwe chinosiyana kunze kwehurefu.
y-m-02-04.s.s3.hint.1: Fungidzira kuzadza makapu ose maviri nemvura kusvika pahurefu hwakafanana uye uenzanise kuti divi ripi rinobata mvura yakawanda.

y-m-02-06.title: Kushongedza poster nezvidimbu 8: nzira dzipi dzinogoneka?

y-m-02-06.goal: Gadzira kwete chimwe chete asi mabatanidzwa akati wandei ehuwandu hwezvidimbu zvemashape anochengeta mamiriro akati wandei panguva imwe, uye uenzanise nzira dzekuawana pasina kusiya.
y-m-02-06.material: Kirasi yaSaerom inoshongedza poster nezvidimbu zvemashape e triangle, quadrilateral, ne circle. Zvidimbu 8 zvose zvinofanira kunamatidzwa. Kune mamiriro matatu. ① Shandisa chidimbu chimwe kana kupfuura che triangle, quadrilateral, ne circle. ② Shandisa zvidimbu zve quadrilateral zvishoma kupfuura zvidimbu ze triangle. ③ Pane zvidimbu 8 zvose. (Hapana mufananidzo, saka funga nezvehuwandu hwezvidimbu chete.)

y-m-02-06.thinking.2: Kuongorora nzira dzekuwana pasina kusiya chinhu

y-m-02-06.s.s3.hint.0: Rongedza mapairi awakawana mutebhura, uye uapatsanure kuti mutsara mumwe i1 quadrilateral, unotevera i2 maquadrilateral, nezvimwewo.
y-m-02-06.s.s3.hint.1: Kana pane chidimbu chequadrilateral 1, tarisa imwe nenguva kuti matriangle ari kubva pamangani kusvika pamangani anogoneka.

y-m-02-06.s.s3.r.a: Hapana nzira yekuongorora kana chimwe chakasiiwa. Funga kuti ungazive sei kuti mapairi awakawana ndiwo ose.
